% type3-unmapped — text in a font whose glyphs have no Unicode value at all.
%
% Under [T1] and without lmodern, pdfTeX draws the EC fonts from METAFONT bitmaps
% and embeds them as Type 3, with glyph names like a16 that are encoding slots and
% not characters (README.md, "Why untagged, and why lmodern"). There is no
% /ToUnicode, no /ActualText and no /Alt, so nothing in the file says what the text
% is. The gold file holds what the source says, so the score measures how much of
% it the converter recovers. Every glyph it cannot recover should come out as [err]
% and never as a guess.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
Every glyph on this page is drawn from a bitmap font with no Unicode mapping.
\end{document}
